import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD = 1000000007L;
    static final long INF_LL = (1L << 28);
    static final int MAX_D = 100;
    static final int MAX_K = 40;

    static long N;
    static int K;

    static Vector<Vector<Long>>[] R = new Vector[MAX_K + 1];
    static Vector<Vector<Vector<Vector<Long>>>> D = new Vector[MAX_D];

    static void allocate_matrix(Vector<Vector<Long>> A, int rows, int cols) {
        A.clear();
        for (int i = 0; i < rows; i++) {
            Vector<Long> row = new Vector<>(cols);
            for (int j = 0; j < cols; j++) {
                row.add(0L);
            }
            A.add(row);
        }
    }

    static Vector<Vector<Long>> mat_mult(Vector<Vector<Long>> A, Vector<Vector<Long>> B) {
        int n = A.size();
        int m = B.size();
        int p = B.get(0).size();
        Vector<Vector<Long>> C = new Vector<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            Vector<Long> row = new Vector<>(p);
            for (int j = 0; j < p; j++) {
                row.add(0L);
            }
            C.add(row);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int k = 0; k < m; ++k) {
                if (A.get(i).get(k) == 0) continue;
                for (int j = 0; j < p; ++j) {
                    long val = (C.get(i).get(j) + A.get(i).get(k) * B.get(k).get(j)) % MOD;
                    C.get(i).set(j, val);
                }
            }
        }
        return C;
    }

    static void print_matrix(Vector<Vector<Long>> A) {
        for (Vector<Long> row : A) {
            for (Long val : row) {
                System.out.print(val + " ");
            }
            System.out.println();
        }
        System.out.println();
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner cin = new Scanner(System.in);
        N = cin.nextLong();
        K = cin.nextInt();

        // Convert N to base-K digits
        Vector<Integer> digits = new Vector<>();
        long base = 1;
        while (base <= N) {
            if (base > N / K) break;
            base *= K;
        }
        if (base > N) base /= K;

        long temp = base;
        while (temp > 0) {
            digits.add((int) (N / temp));
            N %= temp;
            temp /= K;
        }
        Collections.reverse(digits);

        int cnt = digits.size();

        // Pre-allocate R matrices
        for (int j = 0; j <= K; ++j) {
            R[j] = new Vector<>();
            for (int i = 0; i <= K; ++i) {
                Vector<Long> row = new Vector<>();
                for (int k = 0; k <= K; ++k) {
                    row.add(0L);
                }
                R[j].add(row);
            }
        }

        // Pre-allocate D matrices
        for (int i = 0; i <= cnt; ++i) {
            D[i] = new Vector<>();
            for (int j = 0; j < K; ++j) {
                Vector<Vector<Long>> row = new Vector<>();
                for (int k = 0; k <= K; ++k) {
                    Vector<Long> col = new Vector<>();
                    for (int l = 0; l <= K; ++l) {
                        col.add(0L);
                    }
                    row.add(col);
                }
                D[i].add(row);
            }
        }

        // Setup R[0], R[1]
        R[0].get(K).set(K, 1L);
        R[1].get(K).set(K, 1L);
        for (int j = 0; j < K; ++j) {
            R[0].get(j).set(j, 1L);
            R[1].get((j + K - 1) % K).set(j, 1L);
        }

        // Build R[j] for j >= 2
        for (int j = 2; j <= K; ++j) {
            R[j] = mat_mult(R[j - 1], R[1]);
        }

        // Initialize D[0][0]
        for (int j = 0; j <= K; ++j) {
            D[0].get(0).get(j).set(j, 1L);
            D[0].get(0).get(j).set(0, 1L);
        }

        // Build D matrices
        for (int i = 0; i <= cnt; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j < K; ++j) {
                Vector<Vector<Long>> temp1 = mat_mult(R[K - j], D[i].get(0));
                Vector<Vector<Long>> temp2 = mat_mult(temp1, R[j]);
                D[i].get(j).clear();
                D[i].get(j).addAll(mat_mult(D[i].get(j - 1), temp2));
            }
            if (i < cnt) {
                D[i + 1].get(0).clear();
                D[i + 1].get(0).addAll(D[i].get(K - 1));
            }
        }

        // Final computation
        Vector<Vector<Long>> res = new Vector<>();
        Vector<Long> row = new Vector<>();
        for (int i = 0; i <= K; ++i) {
            row.add(0L);
        }
        row.set(K, 1L);
        res.add(row);
        int mod_state = 0;

        for (int i = 0; i < cnt; ++i) {
            if (digits.get(i) != 0) {
                Vector<Vector<Long>> temp1 = mat_mult(R[K - mod_state], D[cnt - i - 1].get(digits.get(i) - 1));
                Vector<Vector<Long>> temp2 = mat_mult(temp1, R[mod_state]);
                res = mat_mult(res, temp2);
            }
            mod_state = (mod_state + digits.get(i)) % K;
        }

        long ans = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i <= K; ++i) {
            ans = (ans + res.get(0).get(i)) % MOD;
        }
        System.out.println(ans);
    }
}
